issues.title: Eq.(15) 缺失二项式系数
issues.description_md: 作者按阶数汇总子集时漏掉组合数量。
issues.impact_md: 同一重构命题用完整二项式消去补正，原错式保留。

en.title: Missing binomial multiplicities in Eq.(15)
en.description_md: The author groups subsets by size without their multiplicities.
en.evidence_md: For $|T|-|L|=2$, the printed sum is $1-1+1=1$, rather than $0$; the correct sum is $1-2+1=0$.
en.impact_md: The same reconstruction claim is repaired by full binomial cancellation; the erroneous source expression is retained.

issues.title: Eq.(16) OR 分组的零因子不成立
issues.description_md: 原分组的符号缺少固定 L 与 T 交集的指数；零因子仍须按两个剩余块完整核对。
issues.evidence_md: 取 $N=\{1,2\},T=\{1\},L=\{1\}$，原式 $S_1=\varnothing,\{2\}$ 的符号与原 $|S|-|L|$ 相反。其分组总和虽可由剩余块消去，但这不使逐项错符号相等。
issues.impact_md: 用全 OR 和减去不激活 OR 和完整补证，不改变定理。

en.title: Invalid zero-factor grouping in Eq.(16)
en.description_md: The grouping omits the fixed-L intersection exponent; zero factors must still be checked using both remaining blocks.
en.evidence_md: For $N=\{1,2\},T=\{1\},L=\{1\}$, the printed signs for $S_1=\varnothing,\{2\}$ are opposite to the original exponent $|S|-|L|$. The grouped sum can still cancel using its remaining blocks, which does not make the printed termwise signs equal.
en.impact_md: Subtracting the inactive OR sum from the full OR sum repairs the proof without changing the theorem.

issues.title: 固定与条件 OR 游戏不可混换
issues.description_md: AND 在 S⊆T 时可限制相等；OR 补集变换在再次掩码后通常改变。
issues.impact_md: 两种重构均证明；限制分解与独立重新学习的分解须分别实例化。

en.title: Fixed and conditional OR games differ
en.description_md: AND restriction agrees for S contained in T; the OR complementary transform generally changes under repeated masking.
en.evidence_md: For $N=\{1,2\}$, $o(U)=\mathbf1_{\{1,2\}\subseteq U}$, and $T=\{1\}$, fixed $O(\{1\})=1$, while $o_T\equiv0$ yields $O_T(\{1\})=0$.
en.impact_md: Both reconstruction forms are proved. A restricted split and an independently relearned split must be instantiated separately.

issues.title: Eq.(2) 字面空集值与定理特设值不同
issues.description_md: Definition 3.2 对所有 S 的公式在空集不等于随后特设基线。
issues.evidence_md: $o(\varnothing)=0,o(N)=1$ 给原公式空值 $-1$，而定理空值 $0$。
issues.impact_md: 非空负变换与原定理空集约定分开保存。

en.title: Eq.(2) has a different literal empty value
en.description_md: The all-S formula in Definition 3.2 differs at the empty set from the later special baseline.
en.evidence_md: $o(\varnothing)=0,o(N)=1$ gives literal empty value $-1$, while the theorem specifies $0$.
en.impact_md: The nonempty negative transform and the theorem’s empty convention are retained separately.

issues.title: Eq.(19) 重复加入输出基线
issues.description_md: AND 求和已经含空集基线，原式又加了一次。
issues.evidence_md: $g\equiv1,a\equiv1,o\equiv0$ 满足原空分量条件，原右端为 $1+1=2\ne1$。
issues.impact_md: 保留显式 b 时删去 AND 求和中的空项；这修复中间式，不解决显著近似的外引缺口。

en.title: Duplicated output baseline in Eq.(19)
en.description_md: The AND sum already contains the empty baseline, which is added again.
en.evidence_md: $g\equiv1,a\equiv1,o\equiv0$ satisfies the stated empty-component conditions, but the printed right side is $1+1=2\ne1$.
en.impact_md: Exclude the empty AND term when keeping explicit b. This repairs the intermediate equality without resolving the external sparse-approximation gap.

issues.title: Lemma 3.4 与 OR 稀疏外引条件未验证
issues.description_md: 补集代数等式不能自动保证学习分量满足所引稀疏定理条件。
issues.evidence_md: 原文缺少对 AND 分量、OR 分量补集游戏的条件检验，也没有给“小”和近似误差的定量定义。
issues.impact_md: 完整原文仍保留，项目给出尾和条件界并将原断言范围标为未完成，未偷添条件。

en.title: Unverified external conditions for Lemma 3.4 and OR sparsity
en.description_md: The complementary algebraic identity does not establish that learned components satisfy the cited sparsity theorem’s conditions.
en.evidence_md: The source does not check the assumptions for the AND component and complemented OR component, or quantify smallness and approximation error.
en.impact_md: The full source remains available. A separate tail-bound result is supplied, while the original assertion’s scope remains unresolved without inserted assumptions.

issues.title: Eq.(12) 不是所需反向掩码
issues.description_md: 原两坐标定义实际互补，Eq.(13) 的第二等号错误。
issues.impact_md: 原坐标错式独立登记；游戏层面的补集负变换证明有效，不把新定义换进原式。

en.title: Eq.(12) is not the required reversed mask
en.description_md: The two printed coordinate definitions are complementary, making the second equality in Eq.(13) false.
en.impact_md: The coordinate error is recorded separately. The complementary-game negative transform remains valid; a new coordinate definition is not substituted into the source.

issues.title: Eq.(8) 在原显著支持下第一等式失败
issues.description_md: 重叠项只在共同显著支持求和，忘记项却从每个本层显著系数减去实际共享值。
issues.evidence_md: 归一化纯 AND 系数本层 $(1/2,1/2)$、末层 $(1/101,100/101)$；原阈值给支持 $\{\{1\},\{2\}\}$ 与 $\{\{2\}\}$。$\operatorname{all}_{l,1}=1$，$\operatorname{overlap}_{l,1}+\operatorname{forget}_{l,1}=1/2+99/202=100/101$。两分解 L1=1 全局最优。
issues.impact_md: 第一子句有完整反例；本例第二子句成立。不能用正确标量引理冒充原总式证明。

en.title: The first Eq.(8) identity fails with the stated salient supports
en.description_md: Overlap uses only the common salient support, while forget subtracts the actual shared coefficient at every current-layer salient coalition.
en.evidence_md: Normalized pure AND coefficients are $(1/2,1/2)$ and $(1/101,100/101)$. The stated thresholds give supports $\{\{1\},\{2\}\}$ and $\{\{2\}\}$. Then $\operatorname{all}_{l,1}=1$, while $\operatorname{overlap}_{l,1}+\operatorname{forget}_{l,1}=1/2+99/202=100/101$. Both splits are globally L1-optimal at value 1.
en.impact_md: The first clause has a full counterexample; the second holds in this witness. The valid scalar lemma does not prove the printed aggregate identity.

issues.title: 比值、平均与归一化的零边界未规定
issues.description_md: 空并集、零总强度、零方差、空显著集合或零归一化因子会产生未定义实数表达。
issues.evidence_md: 原文未分别给这些情况的赋值规则；残差严格界在 κ=0 时也无可行解。
issues.impact_md: 只在原表达有定义时解释数值，不新增隐含零值约定。

en.title: Unspecified zero boundaries of ratios, averages, and normalization
en.description_md: An empty union, zero total strength, zero variance, empty salient family, or zero normalization factor can make the real expression undefined.
en.evidence_md: The source supplies no separate values for these cases; its strict residual bound is also infeasible when κ=0.
en.impact_md: Interpret the metrics where their original expressions are defined, without adding a hidden zero convention.
